title: A Framework for Ethical Decision Making
publisher: Markkula Center for Applied Ethics · Santa Clara University
note: A practical normative framework using rights, justice, consequences, common good, virtue and care. These lenses can disagree. It does not supply a universal answer key or prove that completing a course improves behavior.

title: What an ethical decision framework can—and cannot—do
publisher: Markkula Center for Applied Ethics · Santa Clara University
note: The framework supports careful consideration; it is not an algorithm that decides what is right. Our scenarios and teaching routines are original educational adaptations, not quotations or validated assessments.

title: ACM Code of Ethics and Professional Conduct
note: A professional computing code supporting honesty, privacy, avoiding harm and accountability. Applying these principles to everyday examples is an authored adaptation, not a statement of law or a guarantee that interests never conflict.
